content: {"rules": ["The model exhibits a severe structural bias toward mean reversion, consistently underestimating strong upward trends (e.g., the Nov 2022 spike) and failing to capture the magnitude of price surges when sentiment is positive.", "Forecasts display a significant lag in reacting to regime shifts; the model continues projecting flat or slightly declining paths for 10-15 days after a true breakout occurs, only converging to the new level once the trend reverses.", "The model systematically overshoots on the downside during corrections, predicting deeper declines than actually realized (e.g., Dec 2023), suggesting an over-weighting of negative sentiment signals.", "Sentiment history is underutilized: high sentiment scores (1.00) do not trigger sufficient upward momentum in the forecast, while low sentiment scores fail to adequately dampen the forecast during volatile periods.", "Correction Strategy: Apply a dynamic momentum adjustment that scales with the average sentiment score over the last 5 days; increase forecast slope when sentiment > 0.67 and decrease slope when sentiment < 0.33 to counteract the model's inherent inertia."]}
